title: Straighten and hold a newborn training doll's two sprung legs flat while the other arm closes the footboard
instruction: Measure the training doll's length on the white length board, leaving the blue footboard at the reading, then let go.
context: Paediatric nurses (O*NET 29-1141), medical assistants (31-9092) and community health workers (21-1094) measure infants' recumbent length on a length board at well-baby and growth-monitoring visits. The skill is straightening an infant's two sprung legs and holding them flat: a newborn's legs spring back into flexion, so in the WHO method one hand holds both knees flat while the other slides the footpiece to the heels. Training doll, 45 cm.
setup: Station table; positions in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases, x forward, y to the robot's left; heights above the table top. (1) Infant length board, fixed to the table: white (0.95, 0.95, 0.93) melamine-faced plywood plank 68 x 26 x 1.8 cm, about 2 kg, smooth laminate top with friction 0.35 static / 0.30 dynamic, centred at (20, 10), spanning x 7 to 33 and y -24 to 44. A fixed white plywood headpiece 26 x 1.5 x 16 cm stands on its +y end with its face at y 42.5 (the 0 mm mark). A yellow (0.95, 0.80, 0.15) printed tape 2 cm wide runs along x 31 from 0 mm at y 42.5 to 600 mm at y -17.5, with black (0.05, 0.05, 0.05) ticks every 50 mm. (2) Footboard: blue (0.15, 0.35, 0.85) painted plywood plate 20 x 1.2 x 16 cm on a 20 x 6 x 0.8 cm shoe riding in the board's rail, with a beech (0.80, 0.62, 0.40) handle 2.2 x 5 x 2.2 cm sticking 5 cm out of its back, 12 cm above the board; 0.30 kg in all; it slides along y with 1.5 N static (1.2 N moving) rail friction; its face starts at y -9.5, the 520 mm mark. (3) Newborn length-measurement training doll fitted with torsion-spring hip and knee hinges: vinyl, 45 cm crown to sole, 0.45 kg, skin colour (0.93, 0.78, 0.66), friction 0.6 / 0.5 (shins and feet smooth glossy vinyl, 0.25 / 0.2), lying face up along y with its midline on x 20 and its crown at y 42.4, 1 mm from the headpiece. Head (10 cm round), trunk (10 x 15 x 6.2 cm), arms and a white (0.97, 0.97, 0.97) cloth nappy are one rigid 0.33 kg body. Legs at x 17.4 and 22.6: thighs 3.8 cm thick and 8.5 cm hip to knee (35 g each); shins with feet 8 cm knee to sole (25 g each), feet 3.2 x 2 x 7 cm with the toes up. The hips (at y 13.9, 1.9 cm above the board) and knees are sprung hinges about x: hips 0.07 N m/rad toward 95 deg of flexion, knees 0.05 N m/rad toward 81 deg. At rest the legs are drawn up at hips 80 deg and knees 95 deg with the feet in the air, and the soles reach only the 391 mm mark; with every joint straight the soles are 45.0 cm from the crown.
scoring: Whole-run record (a linkkit History updated every control step and cleared only by the simulator reset) of the hip and knee angles, the crown-to-headpiece gap, each sole's gap to the footboard face, the footboard reading (headpiece face to footboard face) and its speed, the doll's lowest point and trunk position, and each gripper's pad clearance and speed. Touch = both hips at most 12 deg and both knees at most 15 deg, the crown within 2 mm of the headpiece, both soles within 2 mm of the footboard face and in front of it, and the footboard slower than 5 mm/s. Measured = a touch held for 0.5 s at any time. Gates, any time in the run, each gives 0: the doll's lowest point more than 20 mm above the board; the trunk pushed off the board. Ladder at the end of the episode: both legs held straight with the crown on the headpiece for 1 s = 0.25; measured = 0.5; measured and the footboard at the end within 5 mm of a reading taken during the measured touch (within the touch limits a touch reads about 445 to 460 mm on the 450 mm doll) = 0.75; and for the last 1 s every pad of both grippers at least 30 mm from the doll and the footboard with both grippers slower than 5 mm/s = 1.0 (success, which must also hold 1 s). Moving the legs or the footboard back never clears a gate or a measurement. Doing nothing scores 0. Real trial: read the footboard face against the tape on a top photo (to 5 mm); a side photo during the hold shows both knees flat, the crown on the headpiece and both soles on the footboard.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed and the board is fixed. Lay the doll face up on its tape outline, midline on the board's centre line (x 20 cm), crown 1 mm from the headpiece, and let the legs spring up to rest (hips about 80 deg, knees about 95 deg, feet in the air). Slide the footboard to the 520 mm mark (face at y -9.5 cm). object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Rigid links: a 45 cm, 0.45 kg vinyl training doll (a real newborn is about 3.3 kg) whose hip and knee springs (0.07, 0.05 N m/rad) stand in for newborn flexion tone. Hips flex in one plane and the ankles are fixed at 90 deg. The doll does not wriggle; the fixed headpiece stands in for the assistant who holds the head. Shins and feet are slick vinyl (0.25 on the 0.35 laminate) so the heels slide. The footboard slides on a joint with 1.5 N friction; the reading comes from that joint.
